    lack magnitude information. Instead, score each neuron by its mean activation
    magnitude when the predictor keeps it: mean(|act(gate(x))*up(x)| * (logit > 0)).

content = content.replace(old_scoring, new_scoring)

# Fix 3: Add sparsity assertion to _uniform_topk_masks

            masks[li] = (s >= thr).to(torch.bfloat16)
    return masks'''

            masks[li] = (s >= thr).to(torch.bfloat16)

        assert abs(actual_sparsity - sparsity_target) < 0.02, f\"Layer {li}: sparsity {actual_sparsity:.3f} deviates from target {sparsity_target:.3f}\"
    return masks'''
content = content.replace(old_uniform, new_uniform)

with open('src/evaluate.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print('DONE')
